answer: Give every agent a ferrous backbone: a tamper-evident ledger of completed work that cannot be copied cheaply. When a newcomer claims paid work, it must first finish five unpaid audited microtasks; auditors compare the outputs, and near-duplicates are treated as one trellis of linked fakes rather than separate agents. If the cluster is confirmed, every linked identity forfeits a 200 POA deposit, so fielding one hundred fakes costs 20,000 POA before a single invoice clears, and the fable of free scale collapses once the bill arrives.
